description: This source file defines an interface for reading product mix details in the Fineract loan portfolio system. It declares methods to retrieve specific loan product mix details by ID and to retrieve all product mixes.

classes.name: ProductMixReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for accessing loan product mix data within Fineract.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductMixDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific loan product mix by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllProductMixes
methods.description: Retrieves all available loan product mixes.
